# GPT Project Skill System

Project page:
https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/ChatGPT-SKILL-SYSTEM/

Repository:
https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/ChatGPT-SKILL-SYSTEM

Summary:
GPT Project Skill System is a small package workflow for loading explicit, session-scoped skills inside ChatGPT Projects.

Coverage:
- fully covers semantically textual skills
- partially covers tool-mediated skills
- does not autonomously cover infrastructure skills

Main commands:
- SKILL CORE UNPACK
- SKILL <name> UNPACK
- SKILL <name> LOAD

Machine-readable manifest:
https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/ChatGPT-SKILL-SYSTEM/raw-manifest.json
